opening.argument: The speaker presents this as the final part of a free investing course, not a specific investment offer. The discussion gives viewers a framework for portfolio allocation and explains a put option as a potential hedge. It also says the material is not financial advice and warns viewers to invest only what they can afford to lose. The prospect of extraordinary altcoin returns is qualified by the warning that most will go to zero. These are educational explanations with explicit risk limits, not a guaranteed return or a required payment.

citations.quote: This is part 3, the final video in our 3 part FREE course «How to invest in Bitcoin and Crypto».
There is no single correct Bitcoin and crypto allocation, But, there is a framework
Buying a put option gives you the right to sell Bitcoin at a specific price within a defined period, acting like an insurance policy on your position.
This is not financial advice, and only ever invest what you can genuinely afford to lose.
Most will go to 0. A few will generate extraordinary returns.
